In App Store Connect, open Users and Access, then Integrations. Generate a team key with the App Manager role, which Appgotchi will need for releases later. Creating team keys needs Admin or Account Holder access, and Apple lets you download each key only once.
Add the .p8 file you downloaded. Keep its original name so Appgotchi can read the Key ID.
The file was renamed. Enter the Key ID shown next to the key in App Store Connect.
It’s shown above the keys list on the Team Keys page. The Issuer ID isn’t secret.
In Google Cloud, enable the Play Developer Reporting API. Then create a service account and download a JSON key for it.
Add the JSON key file. Appgotchi shows the account email so you can invite it next.
Invite this email under Users and permissions with “View app information and download bulk reports (read-only)”. New permissions can take a few hours to apply.
The key works, but Google hasn’t applied the Play Console permissions yet. This can take a few hours. Keep this screen open and check again, or add the key again later.
